primary_metric.name: RMSE

auxiliary_metrics: previous5/10/20/60/120 returns and risks referenced, not rerun

validation.split_policy: 2022—2024较早成熟历史；2025和2026H1分别评价，全部已见
validation.label_boundary_policy: 训练标签先成熟，评价止于同一期

question.dependence: 同日四ETF、相邻观察及未来20日路径重叠；同步日期20/60日块仅有限敏感性

universe.rationale: 四只已有来源与经济OHLC重建证据的国内宽基ETF，固定有限历史池；不能推断完整ETF总体或账户收益

history.changed_after_results_reason: Separate risk use fixed before new risk predictions; earlier return results and raw risk groups known and retained, no target tuning.

universe_fit.reason: 四只固定国内宽基ETF源身份和经济价可核，但历史到达及行动完整性仍有限，不能外推全体ETF

proxy_fidelity.reason: 两表达公式保持原样，风险用途单列；不是完整时钟、稳定上行或作者唯一标定

method_fit.reason: 各10已知字段和一个表达，固定OLS及简单成熟均值，同资产比重、相同观察，两阶段；样本/秩见本次不含目标值资格

conclusion_scope.reason: 只检验mae20风险信息；既有收益阴性不重做，后期仍已见，资金和交易效果未测量

research.risk.ema_only_wait_age20@1.0.0.name: 当前EMA单独等待日龄的未来20日下探研究用途

definition.formula: X[t]=log(1+age[t]), age consecutive E20=true and S20=false sessions through t

parameters.E: close[t]>first-valid-close seeded EMA20[t], exactly current D01 seed alpha2/21; equality false
parameters.S: close[t]>close[t-20], equality false; E-only is E and NOT S
parameters.wait_age: count of consecutive calendar sessions through t with E-only true. Compute from segment history once E/S both known at21 quotes, not only formal dates. Unknown-start spell is left-censored until E-only ends; no invented prehistory. Missing resets. If S confirms while E remains true, spell ends confirmed at that close; if E becomes false first or simultaneously, failed; formal end/cutoff ongoing. New E-only later is new spell even if E never dropped. No minimum-day stability threshold or max-wait stop.
parameters.added: log1p(wait_age); positive only eligible E-only observations with uncensored age. Fixed monotone compression chosen before outcome; untransformed age retained.
parameters.baseline_box: exact D01 added:100*(close[t]/max(close[t-19:t-9])-1), includes historical closes t-19..t-10 inclusive
parameters.population: all4340scheduled days retained, current E/S states and unknown reason retained; estimation only continuous252economic OHLC, E-only and uncensored current wait age. No selection by later confirmation/success.
parameters.EMA_compatibility: first-close seed follows D01, differs from production SMA-seededEMA. No production change.

definition.unit: log1p sessions; original age sessions retained
definition.transforms: V01来源绑定经济价格；EMA按D01首收盘种子alpha2/21，与生产SMA种子区分
definition.nan_policy: 缺失重置；初次21日状态已在等待则左截断至该段结束；252只控制资格而不重置年龄
definition.endpoints: t及以前的完整日线；未来收盘路径t+1..t+21，含首尾

lifecycle.verification_scope: synthetic target/path/permission and preserved legacy feature tests; source/sample qualification without outcomes; effectiveness separate frozen protocol
